description: Unique identifier of the source MedKit item or onboard medical resource
Unique identifier of the target spaceflight-relevant health condition that the MedKit item may help treat or manage
Original source text describing the medical kit item or treatment capability linked to the condition
example: Intravascular volume replacement [such as intravenous (IV) fluids] and IV start & administration kit

description: Additional information about the relationship between the MedKit item and the health condition
example: This treatment is used to manage dehydration and hypovolemia in astronauts during spaceflight.

description: Information about the route of administration or application of the MedKit item for the health condition
example: IV fluids are administered intravenously to restore fluid balance and maintain blood pressure.
